hadith:
Tricks - Narrated `Umar bin Al-Khattab:

The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'O people! The reward of deeds depends upon the intentions, and every person will get the reward according to what he has intended. So, whoever emigrated for Allah and His Apostle, then his emigration was for Allah and His Apostle, and whoever emigrated to take worldly benefit or for a woman to marry, then his emigration was for what he emigrated for."
message: On the blessed night mentioned in the Quran, Allah reminds us to be mindful of His warnings and guidance. Remember that your intentions shape the true value of your actions—emigrate toward Allah and His purpose, not worldly desires—and trust in Al-Ghaniyy, the Rich One, whose self-sufficiency and provision are perfect, so you need never fear dependence on anything but Him.
name:
Al Ghaniyy - الْغَنِيُّ - The Rich One

The name Al Ghaniyy emphasizes Allah's self-sufficiency and independence from any external support. It reassures believers that Allah is the ultimate provider, in contrast to human dependency and need. The concept originates from the Quran, where Allah is described as possessing all wealth and sufficiency, highlighting His greatness and the assurance to His creation.
verse:
Ad-Dukhan - The Smoke - 44:3

Indeed, We sent it down on a blessed night, for We always warn ˹against evil˺.
